   69 #===============================================================================
   70 # Reduces the user's HP by half of max, and sets its Attack to maximum.
   71 # (Belly Drum)
   72 #===============================================================================
   73 class Battle::Move::MaxUserAttackLoseHalfOfTotalHP < Battle::Move
   74   attr_reader :statUp
   75 
   76   def canSnatch?; return true; end
   77 
   78   def initialize(battle, move)
   79     super
   80     @statUp = [:ATTACK, 12]
   81   end
   82 
   83   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
   84     hpLoss = [user.totalhp / 2, 1].max
   85     if user.hp <= hpLoss
   86       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("But it failed!"))
   87       return true
   88     end
   89     return true if !user.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(@statUp[0], user, self, true)
   90     return false
   91   end
   92 
   93   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
   94     hpLoss = [user.totalhp / 2, 1].max
   95     user.pbReduceHP(hpLoss, false, false)
   96     if user.hasActiveAbility?(:CONTRARY)
   97       user.stages[@statUp[0]] = -Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
   98       user.statsLoweredThisRound = true
   99       user.statsDropped = true
  100       @battle.pbCommonAnimation("StatDown", user)
  101       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} cut its own HP and minimized its {2}!",
  102          user.pbThis, GameData::Stat.get(@statUp[0]).name))
  103     else
  104       user.stages[@statUp[0]] = Battle::Battler::STAT_STAGE_MAXIMUM
  105       user.statsRaisedThisRound = true
  106       @battle.pbCommonAnimation("StatUp", user)
  107       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1} cut its own HP and maximized its {2}!",
  108          user.pbThis, GameData::Stat.get(@statUp[0]).name))
  109     end
  110     user.pbItemHPHealCheck
  111   end
  112 end

  427 #===============================================================================
  428 # Decreases the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage each.
  429 # Increases the user's Attack, Speed and Special Attack by 2 stages each.
  430 # (Shell Smash)
  431 #===============================================================================
  432 class Battle::Move::LowerUserDefSpDef1RaiseUserAtkSpAtkSpd2 < Battle::Move
  433   attr_reader :statUp, :statDown
  434 
  435   def canSnatch?; return true; end
  436 
  437   def initialize(battle, move)
  438     super
  439     @statUp   = [:ATTACK, 2, :SPECIAL_ATTACK, 2, :SPEED, 2]
  440     @statDown = [:DEFENSE, 1, :SPECIAL_DEFENSE, 1]
  441   end
  442 
  443   def pbMoveFailed?(user, targets)
  444     failed = true
  445     (@statUp.length / 2).times do |i|
  446       if user.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(@statUp[i * 2], user, self)
  447         failed = false
  448         break
  449       end
  450     end
  451     (@statDown.length / 2).times do |i|
  452       if user.pbCanLowerStatStage?(@statDown[i * 2], user, self)
  453         failed = false
  454         break
  455       end
  456     end
  457     if failed
  458       @battle.pbDisplay(_INTL("{1}'s stats can't be changed further!", user.pbThis))
  459       return true
  460     end
  461     return false
  462   end
  463 
  464   def pbEffectGeneral(user)
  465     showAnim = true
  466     (@statDown.length / 2).times do |i|
  467       next if !user.pbCanLowerStatStage?(@statDown[i * 2], user, self)
  468       if user.pbLowerStatStage(@statDown[i * 2], @statDown[(i * 2) + 1], user, showAnim)
  469         showAnim = false
  470       end
  471     end
  472     showAnim = true
  473     (@statUp.length / 2).times do |i|
  474       next if !user.pbCanRaiseStatStage?(@statUp[i * 2], user, self)
  475       if user.pbRaiseStatStage(@statUp[i * 2], @statUp[(i * 2) + 1], user, showAnim)
  476         showAnim = false
  477       end
  478     end
  479   end
  480 end
